$description:
Choice contract — form controls that expose checked/selected value state.

Covers Checkbox, Radio, and Switch. This is the visual home for indicators,
dots, thumbs, and on/off tracks. It aliases the older `selection` namespace so
current recipes keep working while new recipes can use the clearer name.

Axis-dependent colour hooks are resolved at the recipe use-site:
  --a63-choice-accent       -> var(--a63-action-primary)
  --a63-choice-border       -> var(--a63-border-control)
  --a63-choice-track-off    -> var(--a63-surface-control)
  --a63-choice-focus-ring   -> var(--a63-focus-ring)

Material hooks are axis-independent defaults. Themes override them to express
glass, bevel, or phosphor treatment without making choice controls inherit the
full Button chrome. Switch maps the box shadows to its track and the indicator
gloss to its checked fill; Checkbox and Radio use the same hooks on their
boxes and indicators.
